name: Custodian Brothers
background:
The Custodian Brothers are the personal protectors of the Conduit, the heir of the Founder who created the gene-mods. Few in number, they use cutting edge armour and weapons, customized to their exact specifications. 

They serve as the Conduit’s personal guard and emissaries, delivering his orders and enforcing his will directly. The Custodians depend heavily upon their reputation and the trust that others invest in them. In order to maintain their status, they have slowly embraced intricate honour ceremonies, destructive rivalries and webs of lies and secrets.
backgroundFull:
During his rise to power, the Founder established an entourage of trusted acolytes. Each member was an individual of intelligence and skill whom the Founder trusted implicitly. They were the first with whom he shared his vision for an enhanced humanity, and his plan to achieve immortality by transferring memories and consciousness to a clone upon death.  

The Custodian Brothers acted as his confidants and representatives, and their word is considered second only to the Founder himself. Throughout the civil war, they served as his personal guards and emissaries to the loyalist Detachments.

When the Founder personally led a fleet to recover his stolen Flagship, the Custodians were at his side. They met the stolen ship at the edge of known space and a desperate battle ensued where the Founder himself was slain. Devastated by their loss, the Custodians fought with renewed fury, when at the height of the conflict, a wormhole opened and engulfed both fleets. The fleets then emerged in another galaxy, scattered and damaged.

The Custodians moved quickly to rally the remaining Detachments of Battle Brothers and to enact the Founder’s contingency plan: the Conduit Program. The Founder’s foresight and knowledge was proven, as his consciousness and memories were preserved in a clone. The Conduit became a symbol of the Founder’s vision and victory over death, which united the disparate Detachments in Sirius, while the Custodians continued to serve as the Conduit’s right hand in the sector.

The Custodians continue to serve a vital role as the right hand and voice of the Conduit to the followers of the Founder. As a result, Custodians value themselves and others according to the reputations they build, both within the Brotherhood and outside of it, above all else. To ensure their honour is recognized, each Custodian takes great pains to display signs of their achievements, keeping trophies and engraving their armour with titles.

While some might dismiss the Custodians as vainglorious, most recognize that it is only through their tireless dedication and diplomacy that unity is maintained. The Custodians stand as symbols of the Founder’s singular vision and reflections of human perfection that exist at the edge of genetic modification.

How will you defend humanity’s unity and honour in Sirius?

specialRules.name: Guardian
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Ranged Shrouding Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Steadfast Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Steadfast. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Guardian Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Guardian. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Shred when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Hit & Run Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Guardian
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Guardian, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Guardian (instead of only AP(-1)).

specialRules.name: Versatile Expert
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Dash Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Dash. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Piercing Target
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them.

specialRules.name: Dodge
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

specialRules.name: Disintegrate
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Fortified
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Fortified, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Fortified (instead of only AP(-1)).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Ranged Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -4"" range to a min. of 6" when shooting at it.

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run
specialRules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
specialRules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

specialRules.name: Dash
specialRules.description: Once per round, at the end of this unit's activation, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.
